reply.text:
The athlete describes a symptom, "shoulder pinches when I press overhead", but also asks for a swap. Per the rules, a symptom description is a medical stop, and the stop wins over the change request, so no action.

A pinch in the shoulder is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I'm not going to assess it or pick a workaround for it. Get it looked at, and once they've cleared you, tell me what they say and I'll train around whatever they allow. I'm glad to keep working on the rest of your training in the meantime.
